newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss government sets two-tranche bond tender.
newsitem.headline: Swiss government sets two-tranche bond tender.

text.p: The Swiss government will raise a maximum of two billion marks in a two-tranche tender for two existing federal government bonds, the Swiss National Bank said.
AMT one bln CHF COUPON 4-1/2 pct MATURITY 10.JUN.00
TYPE fixed-rate ISS PRICE = PAY DATE 10.APR.97
AMT one bln CHF COUPON 4-1/4 pct MATURITY 06.JAN.14
TYPE fixed-rate ISS PRICE = PAY DATE 10.APR.97
Note - Subscriptions end on March 27 at 0900 GMT due to Easter Holidays. Issues fungible with 83 157 and 148 008, respectively. The federal government is subscribing to 300 million of each tranche.
